sentences.text: Soyuz -LRB- Сою́з -LSB- sɐˈjʉs -RSB- , `` Union '' , as in Сове́тский Сою́з , `` Sovetskiy Soyuz '' , `` Soviet Union '' -RRB- is a series of spacecraft designed for the Soviet space programme by the Korolyov Design Bureau -LRB- now RKK Energia -RRB- in the 1960s that remains in service today .	RKK Energia	S.P. Korolev Rocket and Space Corporation Energia	spacecraft	spacecraft	Soviet space programme	Soviet space programme

The Soyuz succeeded the Voskhod spacecraft and was originally built as part of the Soviet manned lunar programs .	spacecraft	spacecraft	Voskhod spacecraft	Voskhod spacecraft	Soviet manned lunar programs	Soviet manned lunar programs

The Soyuz spacecraft is launched on a Soyuz rocket , the most frequently used and most reliable launch vehicle in the world to date .	spacecraft	spacecraft	Soyuz rocket	Soyuz (rocket family)	launch vehicle	launch vehicle

The Soyuz rocket design is based on the Vostok launcher , which in turn was based on the 8K74 or R-7A Semyorka , a Soviet intercontinental ballistic missile .	Soyuz rocket	Soyuz (rocket family)	Vostok	Vostok (rocket)	R-7A Semyorka	R-7A Semyorka	intercontinental ballistic missile	intercontinental ballistic missile
All Soyuz spacecraft are launched from the Baikonur Cosmodrome in Kazakhstan .	spacecraft	spacecraft	Baikonur Cosmodrome	Baikonur Cosmodrome
